Former Apple Retail SVP Ron Johnson joins the show to talk about his new book, "Different: The Story of an Outside-the-Box Retail Genius." Ron looks back on the early days of the Apple Store, working with Steve Jobs, the original iPhone launch event, why he left Apple to become CEO of JCPenney, his thoughts on the current state of Apple retail, and, of course, his take on the iPhone Duo.
